purpose: Supplemental microkernels; these do not measure end-to-end SQL or database throughput.

initial_leaf_probe.limitation: Initial exploratory calls did not record the engine source hash. Keep these as historical evidence; use leaf-key-comparison.json and leaf_key_probe.rb for the reproducible controlled comparison.

controlled_leaf_probe.description: Same loaded core, fake codec, four field reads; legacy structural key implementation compared with current identity key.

type_probe.description: Already-resolved scalar names and exact integer bounds. The type source file hashes are recorded independently; other core files are not exercised by this kernel.

allocations.description: Intermediate source before the final type and EOF optimizations. ObjectSpace records allocation counts, never traced timings. Checksum replay times the unchanged canonical Ruby harness separately.
allocations.script_revision_note: After capture, the script's path classification was corrected for external RUBY_NATIVE_SOURCE snapshots. This recorded run used the working tree, so its allocation groups were unaffected. The report retains its original script hash; timings and raw results were not rewritten.

final_source.description: Final source includes standard fixed-width integer pack/unpack and empty-attachment storage enumeration. These remove 74 allocations per canonical lookup. Short timing samples overlap the preceding source; canonical final-file-* results are the end-to-end evidence.

preceding_source.description: Fully validated preceding source before the last two allocation reductions. Retained as intermediate evidence.
